Question
========
What is the total data capacity, in KBytes, of an 8-way set-associative cache with 64 rows and 64-byte cachelines?


Answerlist
----------
* 16 KB
* 32 KB
* 64 KB
* 4 KB

Solution
========
The capacity is the product of the three dimensions: 8 ways times 64 rows times 64 bytes = 32768 bytes = 32 KBytes.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. This forgets a factor 2; recompute 8 x 64 x 64.
* 1. 8 x 64 x 64 = 32768 bytes = 32 KBytes.
* 0. This is twice the capacity; recompute 8 x 64 x 64.
* 0. This is the capacity of a single row, 8 x 64 bytes, times 8.
